concept: RDS automated backups: point-in-time recovery up to 35 days
tests: Which RDS feature provides daily automated backups for up to 35 days and restore to any point in time.
expected: RDS automated backups — a daily snapshot + transaction logs, PITR to any second within the retention period (up to 35 days). Triggers: "daily automated backups", "35 days", "any point in time".
why_not: Weekly manual snapshots don't give an arbitrary point; copying files to S3 isn't supported; read replicas — scaling/failover, not PITR.
